Name: Radical Reindeer - a Livestock Mod
Author: Radicalvice
Description:
[size=3][b]Summary:[/b][/size]

"Radical Reindeer" adds a brand new barn animal - the reindeer, which can only be bought during winter and if you own a big barn. I'm honestly surprised there hasn't been a mod that does this. It's usually just regular forest deer, not the actually half-domesticated variety.

To make matters more interesting, unlike any other animal, reindeer are more than willing to step outside during the winter. Not rain, though. They're not called "raindeer" now, are they?

The thing comes in twelve total variants:
[list]
[*]Three patterns - [b]speckled[/b], [b]halved[/b] and [b]caribou[/b] - each coming in three colors - [b]brown[/b], [b]gray[/b] and [b]cream[/b];
[*]Plain - nothing to say really. It's a plain white deer;
[*]Poser - the cruddy innacurate reindeer you'd find plastered all over Christmas merchandise, only available from winter 24th 'til the 28th;
[*]Joja - once you sell your soul to the blue company and finish their warehouse, you'll be able to purchase a modified version of the poser. Doesn't that sound fun?
[/list]
As for what you can get from it:
[list]
[*]Reindeer milk - it's milk. From a reindeer, no less;
[*]Antler - once you've earned it's trust, a reindeer will start shedding it's antlers every ten days;
[*]And of course, what's a milk type without cheese? After putting reindeer milk into a cheese press, out will come [b]l[/b][b]eipäjuusto[/b] - a kind of cheese that squeaks when you chew it. I know this item's description will say the exact same thing I just said, but IDC!!!!!!!!!!!!!
[/list][b][size=3]
Installation:[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url];
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url];
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url]﻿;
[*]As usual, download the main .zip file of this mod and extract it within Stardew's mod folder.

[/list]
[b][size=3]Credits:[/size][/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/handwrittenhello?gameId=1303]handwrittenhello[/url] for making the code for this mod and being forced to learn Extra Animal Configs. Couldn't have done it without you.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/birDfiSHi]birDfiSHi[/url], the artstyle of whom inspired the product sprites, because I find it delightful.
